register_cr_netflix_optional_note: AniList is all you need to get started. Crunchyroll and Netflix credentials are optional — you can add them anytime from Settings, or skip them entirely.
reset_invalid_body: This password reset link is invalid, expired, or already used. Ask an admin to generate a new one.
settings_page_sub: Preferences and credentials for this tracker.
settings_timezone_hint: — used for all date and time display
account_linked_desc: Connect Google or Discord to log in without a password. You always need at least one working login method.
twofa_desc: Add an extra login step using a TOTP authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, etc.), on top of your password.
twofa_needs_password: Set a password above first — two-factor authentication is only available for accounts with a local password.
title_2fa_setup: Set up two-factor authentication — Anime Tracker
twofa_setup_intro: Scan this QR code with an authenticator app (Google Authenticator, Authy, 1Password, etc.), then enter the 6-digit code it shows to confirm setup.
twofa_setup_qr_alt: QR code for authenticator app setup
twofa_setup_secret_label: Can't scan? Enter this key manually:
title_2fa_recovery_codes: Save your recovery codes — Anime Tracker
twofa_recovery_desc: Two-factor authentication is now enabled on your account.
twofa_recovery_warning: These codes are shown only once. Save them somewhere safe — each one can be used a single time to log in if you lose access to your authenticator app.
login_2fa_intro: Enter the 6-digit code from your authenticator app.
login_2fa_recovery_hint: Lost your authenticator? Enter one of your recovery codes instead.
account_sessions_desc: Devices currently logged in to your account. Revoke any you don't recognize.
sync_credentials_help: Connect the services AniDex should sync from. Only AniList is required — Crunchyroll and Netflix stay optional, and syncing simply skips whichever of those two isn't configured. Come back and update any card whenever a credential expires.
sync_cr_token_hint: — etp_rt cookie value from your browser
sync_netflix_cookie_help: Full "cookie" request header value from your browser's devtools (Network tab, any netflix.com request, Request Headers → cookie). Needs the whole thing, not just NetflixId/SecureNetflixId — Netflix's viewing-activity API checks several of the other session cookies too.
sync_netflix_guid_help: From the same devtools capture: any api/aui/pathEvaluator request's POST body decodes to {"guid": "..."}; that value.
sync_plex_connect_hint: Sign in with your Plex account to connect a server — no password or token to copy, just click Connect and approve on plex.tv.
cred_needs_attention_note: The last sync couldn't use this credential — it may have expired. Update it below and test the connection again.
cred_guide_anilist_step1: Go to anilist.co/settings/developer while logged in.
cred_guide_anilist_step2: Under "API Clients", create one if you don't already have one.
cred_guide_anilist_step3: Generate an access token for it.
cred_guide_anilist_step4: Copy the token and paste it above.
cred_guide_cr_step1: Log into crunchyroll.com in this browser.
cred_guide_cr_step2: Open your browser's devtools (F12) → Application/Storage → Cookies → crunchyroll.com.
cred_guide_cr_step3: Find etp_rt and copy its value.
cred_guide_netflix_step1: Log into netflix.com in this browser.
cred_guide_netflix_step2: Open devtools → Network tab, then reload the page.
cred_guide_netflix_step3: Click any request to netflix.com → Request Headers → copy the whole cookie value.
cred_guide_netflix_step4: For the profile guid, find an api/aui/pathEvaluator request — its POST body decodes to {"guid": "..."}; that value.
cred_guide_primevideo_step1: Log into primevideo.com in this browser, then open Settings → Watch History.
cred_guide_primevideo_step3: Click any getWatchHistorySettingsPage request → Request Headers → copy the whole cookie value.
sync_manual_desc: Trigger the full sync pipeline on demand instead of waiting for the scheduled run.
sync_outbox_help: Status and progress updates — from bulk edits and from Crunchyroll/Netflix sync alike — are written here immediately and delivered to AniList asynchronously in the background, respecting AniList's rate limit collectively across every source. A sync run finishing "ok" means the updates were staged correctly, not necessarily that every one has reached AniList yet.
sync_csv_import_help: Bootstrap fallback for a large or first-time Netflix account whose full watch history can't reliably complete within Force Full Resync's timeout budget. Download your own export from Netflix (Account → Profile & Parental Controls → Viewing activity → Download all) and upload the CSV here — it's matched against your AniList library the same way a live sync is, and counts as a complete review of your Netflix history once imported.
sync_csv_import_success: Import complete — see Sync history below for details.
sync_cr_overrides_help: Crunchyroll reports a franchise-level title (the same name for every season), while AniList often lists a sequel season under its own suffixed title (e.g. "Kingdom 2nd Season"). Sync already tries common AniList naming conventions automatically — this is only for a title it still gets wrong, or can't find at all. Set the series title exactly as Crunchyroll reports it, the season number, and the AniList entry it should match; sync uses it from then on instead of re-matching.
sync_cr_overrides_empty: No overrides set — sync's automatic matching is used for every title.
sync_cr_overrides_field_season_hint: — defaults to 2, since this form is usually for a season-2+ title Crunchyroll and AniList name differently; change it if yours is a later season
sync_cr_overrides_field_anilist_id_hint: — the number in the correct entry's anilist.co/anime/ URL, e.g. 154587
streaming_services_help: Used to score the marginal-value coverage ranking on the Streaming Coverage page — check every service you currently subscribe to.
library_health_all_clear: No issues found in your library.
library_health_desc: Signals from your own sync history and data over the last {days} days — the same checks admins can see across every user, scoped to just your account.
library_health_orphaned_notes: {count} note(s) attached to an anime no longer in your library
library_health_stale_recs: {count} recommendation(s) still listed for anime you've already added
library_health_drift: {count} entry/entries not updated on AniList in over {days} days
sync_export_desc: Download your full library as JSON — includes AniList data, personal notes, tags, and scores.
sync_import_help: Restore drop reasons, notes, tags, and queue priority from a previously exported library.json. Matched by AniList id — only ever writes to your own account, and existing notes are only overwritten after you confirm.
notif_help: Where sync alerts, new-episode alerts, and the weekly digest get sent. Enable a channel and fill in its details — leave secret fields blank to keep the existing value.
notif_telegram_chat_hint: — your Telegram user or chat ID the bot should message
notif_discord_webhook_hint: — from the target channel's Integrations → Webhooks settings in Discord
notif_ntfy_topic_hint: — pick a hard-to-guess name; anyone who knows it can subscribe on the public server
notif_ntfy_server_hint: — defaults to the public ntfy.sh; set your own for a self-hosted server
notif_ntfy_token_hint: — optional, for a private topic or self-hosted server that requires auth
notif_webpush_unsupported: This browser doesn't support Web Push.
notif_webpush_permission_denied: Notification permission was denied — check your browser's site settings.
notif_webpush_subscribe_failed: Couldn't enable push notifications. Try again.
privacy_help: Controls for any feature that shows your library to other users on this instance (e.g. an "also watching" indicator). Nothing is hidden or anonymized by default — these are opt-in.
privacy_hidden_tags_hint: — entries matching any of these never appear to other users, comma-separated
privacy_anonymize_label: Show my activity anonymously ("a user") instead of by name to other users
upcoming_page_sub: New episodes for your watching & planning list.
on_this_day_started: you started watching this {years} year(s) ago today
on_this_day_finished: you finished watching this {years} year(s) ago today
on_this_day_started_and_finished: you started and finished watching this {years} year(s) ago today
upcoming_empty: No upcoming episodes — nothing currently airing in your list.
queue_page_sub: Ordered by manual priority, then recommender score. Set a priority from any title's notes page to pin it to the top.
queue_watched_confirm: Mark all {num} remaining episodes as watched and set status to Completed?
queue_empty: Nothing in your planning or paused list.
queue_rewatch_sub: Completed shows finished {months}+ months ago, sorted by longest since.
queue_rewatch_empty: Nothing due for a rewatch yet.
notes_drop_reason_placeholder: Why did you drop this? (leave blank if not applicable)
notes_mood_hint: — how did it feel to watch? Pick as many as fit
notes_queue_priority_hint: — lower = watch sooner, leave blank for no override
notes_anilist_override_hint: — if AniList links to the wrong entry, set the correct ID here
notes_rewatch_hint: Separate from the general note above — one note per rewatch, so "this rewatch hit different" doesn't overwrite or blend into the original watch's note.
notes_filler_matched_empty: Matched on AniFillerPedia, but no episodes have been researched yet.
notes_filler_researched_hint: Based on {n} episode(s) researched so far — may not cover the full series.
stats_drilldown_hint: Click a number, bar, or slice to see the anime behind it.
stats_chart_status_empty: Add anime to your library to see your status breakdown here.
stats_chart_genres_empty: Complete a title to see your top genres here.
stats_chart_year_empty: Complete a title to see your completions by year here.
stats_wrapped_no_prior_year: No prior-year data yet — this is your first year with completions on AniDex.
stats_rec_sub: {hits} of {eligible} tracked recommendations were added to your list or rated 4★+ within {window} days of being suggested.
stats_rewatch_list_empty: No rewatches yet — anything you watch again will show up here.
stats_rewatch_dist_empty: Complete a title to see rewatch stats here.
stats_taste_drift_sub: Genre mix of your completed library over time — {usable} of {total} completed titles have a recorded finish date and are shown below, bucketed {granularity}.
stats_studio_loyalty_sub: Average score vs. completed titles per studio, for studios with at least {min_titles} completed and rated titles — showing {shown} of {total} studios ({excluded_low_volume} below the title threshold, {excluded_unscored} not yet rated).
stats_format_split_sub: Episode-based and movie-runtime watch time kept separate, instead of blended into one estimated-minutes figure.
stats_seasonal_sub: Of {judged} shows you started watching during their original airing window, {followed} were kept up with and {dropped} were dropped or never caught up.
stats_seasonal_excluded_line: {count} more are still airing — too early to call yet.
stats_streaming_no_owned: Set which streaming services you already own to see which one would unlock the most of your backlog.
stats_streaming_covered: Your Watching/Planning backlog is already covered by the services you own.
stats_streaming_top_line_singular: Adding {service} would unlock {count} more episode from your Watching/Planning backlog.
stats_streaming_top_line_plural: Adding {service} would unlock {count} more episodes from your Watching/Planning backlog.
title_stats_wrapped: Your Year So Far — Anime Tracker
stats_wrapped_page_sub: Always up to date — no year picker, this just reflects however far into the year you are today. For year-over-year comparisons, use the "Year in anime" card on Stats instead.
stats_wrapped_empty: Nothing completed yet in {year} — check back once you've finished something.
stats_wrapped_highest_rated_empty: No scored completions yet this year.
stats_wrapped_pace_ahead: You're ahead of last year's pace by {pct}% ({episodes} vs {prior_episodes} episodes by this point in the year).
stats_wrapped_pace_behind: You're behind last year's pace by {pct}% ({episodes} vs {prior_episodes} episodes by this point in the year).
stats_wrapped_pace_on_pace: Right on pace with last year ({episodes} vs {prior_episodes} episodes by this point in the year).
stats_wrapped_pace_no_data: No data from {prior_year} yet to compare your pace against.
rec_scored_against: scored against your completed & watching history
rec_season_badge_title: New this season — issue #13's seasonal discovery digest
rec_score_badge_title: The recommender's underlying match score, normalized against your best-scoring candidate when this batch was generated — a different calculation from the % Match badge below
rec_score_unavailable_title: Not enough watch history yet to score this — shown as a seasonal discovery pick instead
rec_match_percent_title: How this recommendation compares to the others currently shown to you — a normalized 0-100 read of the underlying score, not a change to how it's ranked
rec_anilist_votes_title: AniList's community recommendation vote count for this pairing
rec_planning_badge_title: Already on your Planning list — this isn't a new discovery, just scored so it can be prioritized in "watch next"
rec_dismiss_not_now_title: Hide for 30 days, then it comes back
rec_empty: No recommendations yet — run the recommender to generate them.
rec_seen_it_hint: Rate it (optional) then confirm to mark as completed on AniList.
lib_search_placeholder: Filter by title, genre or tag…
lib_notes_drop_hint: Add a reason below, then confirm to drop.
lib_ep_note_placeholder: Write a note for this episode…
lib_ep_note_quote_placeholder: e.g. a line of dialogue, a scene that stuck with you…
admin_users_desc: Login activity and each user's most recent sync run.
admin_deactivate_confirm: Deactivate {email}? They will be logged out immediately and unable to log back in until reactivated.
admin_disable_2fa_confirm: Disable two-factor authentication for {email}? Use this if they've lost their authenticator and all their recovery codes — they'll need to set 2FA up again from Settings if they want it back on.
admin_impersonate_confirm: Start a time-boxed support session logged in as {email}? This is fully audited and ends automatically after a short window.
impersonation_banner_text: You are viewing as {user_email}, started by {admin_email}. This session ends automatically at {expires_at}.
admin_invite_revoke_confirm: Revoke the invite for {email}? They won't be able to sign up with this email until re-invited.
admin_sync_schedule_help: Times are UTC. Applies instance-wide, to every user's sync. The daily sync runs the full pipeline (Crunchyroll/Netflix fetch → AniList → Postgres). The recommender scores unwatched/planning titles weekly.
admin_backups_desc: A full-instance export, taken automatically at the time above. Kept for the most recent 14 backups.
admin_privacy_defaults_help: Instance-wide hidden tags/genres for cross-user visibility features — unioned with each user's own hidden-tags list from Settings, never replaces it. Opt-in only: leave empty and nothing is hidden by default.
admin_oauth_desc: Optional — local email/password login always works regardless of these.
admin_instance_health_desc: Read-only sanity check after a deploy or migration — no restart/migrate controls here, display only.
admin_pending_migrations_warning: {count} migration(s) not yet applied to this database — see migrations/ and CLAUDE.md's manual-apply steps
admin_anilist_ratelimit_active: Currently rate-limited (last seen from {source}) — retrying automatically
admin_anilist_ratelimit_clear: Clear — no rate limit currently active
admin_audit_log_desc: Chronological record of admin actions (invites, OAuth settings, privacy defaults, password resets, user deactivation). Most recent first.
admin_backup_desc: Export every user's library data (same query as each user's own Settings → Data export) as one zip, one JSON file per user. Manual trigger only — not scheduled.
admin_dq_provider_sync_desc: Most recent full-sync run at which each provider's step succeeded, derived from sync_log — no separate per-provider tracking.
admin_dq_failure_history_desc: Full-sync runs in the last {days} days, per user.
admin_dq_no_runs: No sync runs in the last {days} days.
admin_dq_orphaned_notes_desc: personal_notes rows with no matching library_entries row — should be impossible in steady state; usually means the library entry was removed without the note being cleaned up alongside it.
admin_dq_stale_recs_desc: recommendation_scores candidates that have since been added to the user's library but weren't cleared out — the inverse of a literal "no matching library entry" check, since every recommendation candidate is generated for an anime NOT yet in the library by design (see run_recommender.py). These are the ones that should have been.
admin_dq_drift_desc: Watching/Repeating library entries whose AniList-side last-updated timestamp hasn't moved in over {days} days — a possible sign a provider sync has silently stopped picking up that show.
js_confirm_delete: Remove "{title}" from your library and AniList? This can't be undone here.
streaming_page_sub: Which un-owned streaming service would unlock the most of your Watching/Planning backlog, ranked by episodes remaining.
streaming_disclosure: AniList's streaming links are community-curated and can lag real availability — treat this as a guide, not a guarantee.
streaming_glance_no_setup: You haven't set which streaming services you own yet — add them in Your Setup below to see your coverage.
streaming_glance_empty_universe: Nothing in your Watching, Planning, or airing-soon list yet — there's no coverage to measure.
streaming_glance_fully_covered: Your owned services already cover everything in your list ({covered} episodes).
streaming_glance_coverage: Your {owned_count} owned service(s) cover {pct}% of your list ({covered} of {total} episodes).
streaming_glance_cancel: {service} is fully redundant — safe to cancel.
streaming_glance_swap: {service} alone would match or beat your current coverage ({episodes} episodes) — worth considering as a swap.
streaming_group_recommendations_summary_: Set up your owned services to see recommendations
streaming_group_timing_summary: {count} service(s) tracked over the next 12 months
streaming_group_timing_summary_empty: Nothing airing in the next 12 months yet
streaming_group_history_summary_empty: No Completed or Dropped titles with streaming links yet
streaming_owned_empty: You haven't set which streaming services you own yet.
streaming_universe_desc: Every title in Watching, Planning, or with an episode still airing that you're tracking (Completed excluded) — the full set your coverage is measured against.
streaming_minimal_desc: The smallest combination of services you already own that keeps access to everything reachable at all (greedy set-cover, not guaranteed globally optimal).
streaming_minimal_none_owned: You haven't set which streaming services you own yet — see Settings.
streaming_minimal_fully_uncovered: None of your owned services cover anything in your coverage universe.
streaming_uncovered_title: Not available anywhere we know of
streaming_uncovered_desc: These titles aren't on any recognized streaming service per AniList's data — no service, owned or not, would unlock them.
streaming_uncovered_empty: Every title in your coverage universe is on at least one recognized streaming service.
streaming_marginal_title: What each service you own uniquely covers
streaming_marginal_desc: For each service you own, the titles only reachable through that one — what you'd lose by dropping it.
streaming_marginal_none_owned: Set which streaming services you own in Settings to see this.
streaming_marginal_zero_unique: Nothing unique here — every title it covers is also on another service you own.
streaming_cancel_desc: For each service you own, what fraction of your actual Watching/Planning list would become uncovered if you cancelled it — sorted safest-to-cancel first.
streaming_cancel_none_owned: Set which streaming services you own in Settings to see this.
streaming_cancel_zero_impact: Cancelling this loses nothing — every title it covers is also on another service you own.
streaming_swap_desc: An un-owned service whose coverage alone matches or beats what your owned services cover combined.
streaming_swap_none: No un-owned service matches or beats what your owned services already cover together.
streaming_swap_line: {service} alone covers {count} — as much as, or more than, your {owned_count} owned service(s) cover combined ({owned_total}).
streaming_full_ranked_desc: All recognized services, owned or not, ranked by coverage of your universe — no cutoff.
streaming_full_ranked_empty_universe: Your coverage universe is empty — nothing in Watching, Planning, or airing soon yet.
streaming_full_ranked_zero_titles: Doesn't cover anything in your coverage universe.
streaming_genre_desc: Your top genres by average rating (Completed titles only), and how much of each is still covered by which service across your Watching/Planning/Upcoming list.
streaming_genre_empty: Not enough rated titles yet to break coverage down by genre — rate a few more Completed titles to unlock this.
streaming_genre_min_titles_note: Only genres with at least {count} rated titles are shown.
streaming_genre_no_coverage: Nothing from this genre is currently in your Watching/Planning/Upcoming list.
streaming_footprint_desc: Informational only — doesn't affect the ranking above.
streaming_footprint_empty: No Completed or Dropped titles with streaming links yet.
streaming_calendar_sub: Which of the next 12 months each service actually has something airing from your Watching/Planning list — only pay for the months it does.
streaming_calendar_empty: No upcoming airing episodes found for your Watching/Planning list yet.
pat_desc: Issue a token to let an external MCP client (like Claude Code) read — and, for read+write tokens, make changes to — your own AniDex library, notes, stats, and recommendations. Read-scope tokens also work for polling /api/ha/status from Home Assistant. Every token is scoped to your account only.
pat_scope_help: Read & write lets the client change notes, tags, ratings, status, and progress on your behalf. Choose read only unless the client actually needs to make changes.
pat_created_desc: Personal access token "{name}" has been created.
pat_created_warning: This token is shown only once. Copy it now and store it somewhere safe — you won't be able to see it again. If you lose it, revoke it and create a new one.
js_collection_delete_confirm: Delete the "{name}" collection? This can't be undone.
whats_new_title: What's new since your last visit
whats_new_episodes_many: {count} new episodes aired for {title} (now at Ep {latest})
whats_new_sync_had_error: {runs} sync run(s), including one that needs attention
